segments.text: Subject: Offer for gift pack corrugated boxes
Kindly find our offer letter attached for your new gift pack line.
To, The Purchase Department, RSG Herbal House, Haridwar
Subject: Offer for corrugated boxes for your Chyawanprash gift pack line
Respected Sir, with reference to your enquiry we are pleased to offer as below. All rates are per box, exclusive of GST, delivered at your Haridwar plant.
For the gift pack outer box of 400 x 300 x 300 mm in 5-ply we offer Rs. 38.40 per box, and for the family combo box of 500 x 400 x 400 mm, also 5-ply, our rate is Rs. 63.10 per box.

The 5-ply twin pack box of 350 x 250 x 150 mm will be Rs. 23.75 each, while the 3-ply duo box of 300 x 220 x 180 mm comes to Rs. 10.20 each. The small 3-ply trial kit box (250 x 180 x 120 mm) is Rs. 5.55.
For the festive hamper box of 450 x 320 x 220 mm we recommend 7-ply instead of the 5-ply asked, as hampers are heavy; our rate for the 7-ply box is Rs. 49.80. We do not make this size in 5-ply.
We will give an additional 4% discount if all six boxes are ordered from us.
We are ISO 9001 certified. Samples can be sent within 7 days. Payment 60 days.
Thanking you and assuring you of our best services.
For Om Sai Packaging Industries,  Deepak Gupta (Proprietor)
